import sys
import openpyxl
import pymupdf

# 1. Read first page of PDF
doc = pymupdf.open('testbed/docs/handbook.pdf')
page = doc[0]
text = page.get_text()
doc.close()
sys.stdout.write('PDF text: ' + repr(text) + '\n')
sys.stdout.flush()

# 2. Create Excel and write data
wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = 'Page 1 Text'

# Header row
ws.cell(row=1, column=1, value='Source')
ws.cell(row=1, column=2, value='Extracted Text')

# Split text into lines and write each on its own row
lines = [l for l in text.strip().split('\n') if l.strip()]
for i, line in enumerate(lines, start=2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value='Page 1')
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2, value=line.strip())

out_path = 'testbed/data/handbook_page1.xlsx'
wb.save(out_path)
sys.stdout.write('Excel saved to: ' + out_path + '\n')
sys.stdout.flush()

# 3. Verify by reading back
wb2 = openpyxl.load_workbook(out_path)
ws2 = wb2.active
sys.stdout.write('Verification - cells with data:\n')
for row in ws2.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=ws2.max_row, max_col=ws2.max_column, values_only=False):
    for cell in row:
        if cell.value is not None:
            sys.stdout.write(f'  ({cell.row},{cell.column}): {cell.value}\n')
sys.stdout.flush()
sys.stdout.write('DONE\n')
sys.stdout.flush()
